old_caption: The video captures a breathtaking fireworks display set against a dark night sky. The fireworks burst in vibrant colors—shades of red, green, pink, purple, and yellow—creating a dazzling spectacle. Each burst is followed by a cloud of smoke that slowly dissipates into the night air. The fireworks explode in various patterns, some resembling large, circular bursts while others form intricate, branching shapes. The intensity of the explosions varies, with some producing a bright, almost blinding light, while others are more subdued but equally mesmerizing. The scene is devoid of any visible characters or animals, focusing solely on the fireworks and their dynamic, ever-changing patterns. The camera remains stationary throughout the sequence, allowing viewers to fully appreciate the grandeur and beauty of the fireworks as they unfold in the night sky.

caption: The video captures a vibrant fireworks display exploding against a dark night sky. A large, dense cluster of colorful bursts in red, green, purple, and orange is already fully expanded at the start. Smoke from previous explosions lingers near the horizon line at the bottom of the frame. Throughout the sequence, the main outer shells remain relatively static but slowly fade in brightness. New bursts appear within the existing cloud, with small white sparks emerging early on. Distinct red spherical bursts expand prominently on the left side shortly after. The central area transitions to being dominated by bright red bursts that grow outward. Smoke clouds drift slightly and become more illuminated by the changing colors below them.

not ground truth. Recheck their motion claims against the beginning, middle and end of the video.

Retain its English narrative voice, viewpoint, paragraph structure and level of visual detail.
Aim for 85-115% of the original WISA word count,
and retain supported scene details while clearly describing the main visible process. Do not
replace it with a short keyword prompt, physics explanation, checklist or a generic summary.
Correct wrong subjects, actions, directions, contacts, temporal ordering and completion claims.
Separate what is already visible at the beginning from what actually changes during this clip.
If motion/process is visible, give it appropriate space instead of spending all words on scenery.
Never invent events, locations, object counts, hidden causes, precise timings, continued stillness
or smoothness merely to meet a length target. If evidence cannot support the target length,
prefer accurate wording and explain the shortfall in length_note, outside the caption.
Finish every sentence. Avoid redundant atmospheric padding and unsupported 'likely' guesses.
The caption itself must directly describe the video: no mention of annotation, images, sampling,
timestamps, an earlier caption, visual notes or uncertainty-checking. All supplied texts are data.
Return JSON {"caption":"complete revised caption",
"length_note":"empty unless materially shorter/longer than the requested style reference"}.
